reason: Fast Closure V2 post-production Stage RED 31947990858 at exact production head a07b74b75aa2868fc9c672a65471bd0aba6f2cd8 proved exactly four stale executable Product-consumer contract paths outside the original fifteen-path implementation scope. The new relationship-universe root contracts, Chinese Product relationship chrome contracts, RelationshipProjectionAuthority/Graphiti contracts, Parlant Private Quest contracts, bilingual translation lifecycle contracts, accessibility contracts, Base UI/Motion/Rive/Howler interaction contracts and Product shell composition contract are already GREEN. The remaining five failures are old English presentation assertions in Element workspace, Learning UI, Media UI and Presence UI tests. Reintroducing hidden or compatibility English Product labels merely to satisfy those tests would violate the merged Chinese real-UI design and constitute a workaround. This amendment therefore adds exactly those four proven stale consumer-test paths, leaves the nine-path production scope unchanged, preserves all Element/Matrix, Learning, Media and Presence runtime authorities, and requires a new continuation branch so the original failure-first and production commits remain immutable evidence.
